comment: Base class roster. Stats use a 1-10 scale, converted at load time. Unique mechanics for non-MVP classes are metadata until their implementation slices land.

actives.desc: 360 AoE slash, 130% dmg, light knockback
3-tile pierce dash, 90% dmg

passives.desc: 3-hit chain -> 4th hit +40% dmg
dash within 0.5s after being hit refunds 50% dash cd

ultimate.desc: dash through all enemies in a line, 3 hits x 80% each

actives.desc: ground slam AoE 200%, stun 1s, breaks armored enemies
3s hyper armor, immune to knockback/interruption

passives.desc: fully charged strikes +50% dmg and +30% cleave width
standing still during heavy swings reduces incoming dmg by 20%

ultimate.desc: leap slam target point for 400% AoE and stone waves in four directions

actives.desc: 2s stealth, next hit guaranteed crit
poison knife for 3s and mark target for +15% dmg taken

passives.desc: back attacks deal +60% dmg
free dash for 2s after killing an elite or marked target

ultimate.desc: teleport slash 5 random targets for 150% each

actives.desc: block 100% front damage for 1.5s and reflect 50% blocked damage
taunt enemies in 5 tiles for 3s, +2 temporary armor

passives.desc: melee attackers take 10% maxHP reflected damage
below 30% HP gain +30% armor

ultimate.desc: 3s invulnerable taunt, then blast 250% scaled by blocked damage

actives.desc: orb of equipped element, small AoE 120%
3x3 zone slows enemy projectiles 50% for 4s

passives.desc: element swap (10s cd) -> +20% spell dmg for 5s
element shard pickup restores 10 mana

ultimate.desc: 12 elemental projectiles rain near cursor over 3s, 100% each

actives.desc: 7 arcing arrows on target zone, 80% each
root trap 1.5s, max 2 placed

passives.desc: fully charged shots: 50% armor pierce + pass through 1 target
auto hop-back when enemy closes within 1 tile (3s cd, no dash cost)

ultimate.desc: giant arrow crosses the screen, 500%, drags enemy projectiles along

actives.desc: bouncing grenade, 150% AoE
next magazine carries equipped element and pierces

passives.desc: kills grant +15% fire rate for 3s, stacks 3 times
can carry a third gun during a run

ultimate.desc: 5s no reload, +60% fire rate, slight homing rounds

actives.desc: summon a temporary fighting spirit for 30s
detonate one pet for 180% AoE and restore 15 mana

passives.desc: each living pet grants all pets +4% dmg
20% incoming owner dmg is split across pets

ultimate.desc: for 8s killed enemies revive as temporary allied spirits

actives.desc: piercing light ray, 110%, blinds 1s
3x3 zone heals 3% maxHP/s for 5s and purges debuffs

passives.desc: after 6s without damage, regenerate 2% maxHP/s
+30% dmg versus undead and shadow enemies

ultimate.desc: giant light pillar 300%, stuns undead, clears poison/curse zones

actives.desc: place a 15s turret, max 2
disable one trap for 10s or flip it to your side

passives.desc: hacked traps have a 30% chance to become allied for the room
mechanical enemies can drop parts that restore 10 energy

ultimate.desc: 8s mech shell blocks four directions and fires two cannons, -30% speed
